def fetch(is_public):
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    items=[]
    while True:
        resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, query='', is_public=is_public, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None)
        print('fetch is_public', is_public, 'page', page_index, 'n', (len(resp) if isinstance(resp, list) else len(resp.get('playlists',[])) if isinstance(resp, dict) else 'NA'))
        if not resp:
            break
        if isinstance(resp, dict):
            batch = resp.get('playlists') or []
        else:
            batch = resp
        items.extend(batch)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index>200:
            break
    return items

public_playlists = fetch(True)
private_playlists = fetch(False)

# Combine unique by playlist_id
all_map={}
for p in public_playlists+private_playlists:
    all_map[p['playlist_id']]=p
all_playlists=list(all_map.values())
print('public count', len(public_playlists))
print('private count', len(private_playlists))
print('combined unique playlists', len(all_playlists))
print('playlist ids:', sorted([p['playlist_id'] for p in all_playlists]))
print('titles:', [(p['playlist_id'], p['title']) for p in sorted(all_playlists, key=lambda x: x['playlist_id'])])

username='ismill@gmail.com'
password=[c for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0]['password']
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username=username, password=password)['access_token']

playlist_ids=[127,128,129,130,131,132]

results=[]
for pid in playlist_ids:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    title=pl.get('title')
    songs=pl.get('songs',[])
    total_seconds=sum(s.get('duration',0) for s in songs)
    results.append({'playlist_id':pid,'title':title,'num_songs':len(songs),'total_seconds':total_seconds,'total_minutes':total_seconds/60})
    print(pid, title, 'songs', len(songs), 'total_seconds', total_seconds)

# find longest
longest=max(results, key=lambda x: x['total_seconds'])
print('longest', longest)
print('rounded_minutes', round(longest['total_minutes']))
